author: Asmodeus733
what_it_is: All levels completed on all difficulty, all challenges completed with 4 players.
format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak: note NPDE/4Y "PERFECT DARK", 28 pages; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert perfect-dark-2000.1043.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD wrong in every copy, rewritten as 0101/FEF1

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save: Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...

The pak as downloaded (ID block checksums 0101/FEFD) gets "Damaged Controller Pak: Controller Pak 1 is damaged or inserted incorrectly. Attempt Repair / Retry / Continue without using" in this core.
